method: Original STL process=False triangle intersections; both-ray parity required for sampled occupied widths. Specific component root rays and face backing controls; no mesh repair, rebuild, exhaustive thickness, slicer, or printability claim.

cap_root_section_support.method: Original STL process=False triangle-plane sections, canonical edge interpolation, six-decimal endpoint graph with degree-two closure and original Polygon validity; exact polygon intersection between levels, no repair or ideal support shapes.
cap_root_section_support.interpretation: Single solid cap receives four distinct original column root patches; each patch retains one nonempty core at 0.4 mm erosion. The union of support patches is four components, not falsely described as one.

cap_face_interior_sampling_region: Surface z 41.4 to 43.5 mm, lateral -0.5, 0, +0.5 of half-width; avoids immediate bottom, top and lateral corners. Selected only by predeclared coordinates, not measured result.
cap_notes: Surface-normal first solid intervals tested against finite convex cap chord, with original-face normals and before/mid/after parity controls. Near-bottom surface-normal chords ending on z40.658 outer bottom plane and deliberate corner grazing chords are explicitly separately classified; reported minimum is not concealed. Expected convex geometry is cross-check only, never substituted for original triangles. No exhaustive global minimum claim.
